story_description: Users launching Blaze for the first time need guided onboarding that detects installed AI CLIs, offers one-click installation for missing ones, and configures the environment automatically so they can start coding immediately.
task_description: Implement the Agents Recommendations screen that presents a filterable grid of pre-configured agent cards organized by use case (Planning, Debugging, Security, Performance, Documentation, Testing), allowing users to select which agents to enable during onboarding.
atom: Agents Recommendations Screen with Filterable Grid
atom_description: A SwiftUI view presenting agent recommendations in a responsive grid layout with category filters (Planning, Debugging, Security, Performance, Documentation, Testing), checkbox selection for each agent, bulk select/deselect actions, and storage of user selections for post-onboarding configuration.
problem_statement: Users need to discover and select from available agent configurations during onboarding. Without a curated recommendations screen, users would need to manually configure agents after setup, creating friction and potentially missing valuable automation capabilities. A filterable grid enables quick discovery and selection based on intended use cases.
scope_in: Display grid of agent cards with name, icon, description, and use case category
Implement category filter bar to show agents by use case (All, Planning, Debugging, Security, Performance, Documentation, Testing)
Enable checkbox selection on each agent card for multi-select behavior
Provide Select All and Deselect All buttons for bulk actions
Show selected count badge in header
Store user selections in OnboardingState for later installation
Support keyboard navigation between cards and filters
Implement search field to filter agents by name or description
Display agent capability tags on each card
Navigate to next screen with Continue button
scope_out: Agent installation or configuration during this screen - deferred to completion screen
Custom agent creation or editing - advanced feature for settings
Agent preview or dry-run functionality - future enhancement
Importing agents from external sources - deferred to settings
Dependency checking between agents - all agents are independent for MVP
Per-agent settings customization - handled in dedicated agent settings screen
assumptions: Pre-defined agent catalog exists with at least 12 agents across 6 categories
Each agent has icon asset, name, description under 100 characters, and single primary category
Users understand agent concepts from previous onboarding screens
Agent data is bundled with app, not fetched from remote
All agents are compatible with all supported CLIs
constraints: Grid must render at least 12 agents without performance degradation
Filter transitions must animate smoothly at 60fps
Card checkboxes must have minimum 44x44pt touch target for accessibility
Must support VoiceOver navigation in logical grid order
Screen must be usable without filter or search if user wants to browse all
Selections must persist if user navigates back and returns to this screen
functional_requirements: FR1: On view appear, load agent catalog from bundled JSON and display all agents in responsive grid layout
FR2: Display category filter bar with All, Planning, Debugging, Security, Performance, Documentation, Testing options
FR3: Tapping a category filter animates grid to show only matching agents with smooth transition
FR4: Each agent card displays icon, name, description, category badge, capability tags, and selection checkbox
FR5: Tapping anywhere on agent card toggles its selection checkbox state
FR6: Header shows 'N agents selected' count that updates in real-time as selections change
FR7: Select All button selects all visible agents based on current filter
FR8: Deselect All button clears all selections regardless of current filter
FR9: Search field filters agents by name or description text with debounced 300ms delay
FR10: Continue button navigates to next onboarding screen and saves selections to OnboardingState
FR11: Back button preserves current selections when returning to previous screen
FR12: Keyboard arrow keys navigate between cards with visible focus ring
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Grid renders 20 agent cards within 100ms with no dropped frames
NFR2: Filter animation completes within 300ms using matched geometry effect
NFR3: Checkbox state change reflects in UI within 16ms (single frame)
NFR4: Memory footprint stays under 30MB including all agent icon assets
NFR5: VoiceOver reads card content in order: name, category, description, selection state
NFR6: Search results update within 350ms of keystroke (300ms debounce + 50ms render)
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create AgentsRecommendationsView.swift with @StateObject for AgentsRecommendationsViewModel
Step 2: Define AgentCategory enum with cases: all, planning, debugging, security, performance, documentation, testing
Step 3: Create AgentRecommendation model with id, name, iconName, description, category, tags, isSelected
Step 4: Create AgentCatalog struct that loads bundled agents.json and provides filtering methods
Step 5: Implement AgentsRecommendationsViewModel with Published properties for agents, selectedCategory, searchText, selections
Step 6: Create loadAgents method that parses bundled agents.json into [AgentRecommendation]
Step 7: Implement computed property filteredAgents that applies category and search filters
Step 8: Create toggleSelection method that updates selection Set and publishes change
Step 9: Implement selectAll method that adds all visible agent IDs to selection Set
Step 10: Implement deselectAll method that clears selection Set entirely
Step 11: Create computed property selectedCount returning selection Set count
Step 12: Build CategoryFilterBar subview with horizontal scroll of category buttons with pill styling
Step 13: Implement category button with selected state animation and matched geometry ID
Step 14: Create SearchField subview with magnifying glass icon and clear button
Step 15: Implement debounced search using Combine publisher with 300ms delay
Step 16: Build AgentCardView subview with icon, name, description, category badge, tags row, and checkbox overlay
Step 17: Add matchedGeometryEffect to agent cards for smooth filter animation
Step 18: Implement checkbox as overlay in top-right corner with checkmark animation
Step 19: Create responsive LazyVGrid with adaptive column sizing (min 160pt, max 200pt)
Step 20: Add header view with selected count badge and Select All / Deselect All buttons
Step 21: Implement keyboard navigation handler using focusedValue and arrow key events
Step 22: Add focus ring style to cards for keyboard navigation visibility
Step 23: Wire up Continue button to save selections to OnboardingState and navigate forward
Step 24: Wire up Back button to preserve state and navigate backward
Step 25: Create bundled agents.json with 12+ agents across all categories
Step 26: Add telemetry for screen load, filter usage, search usage, and selection patterns
Step 27: Write unit tests for ViewModel filtering and selection logic
Step 28: Write UI tests for card interaction, filter transitions, and navigation
data_model_changes: Add AgentCategory enum with rawValue strings: all, planning, debugging, security, performance, documentation, testing
Add AgentRecommendation struct with fields: id (String), name (String), iconName (String), description (String), category (AgentCategory), tags ([String]), isRecommended (Bool)
Add AgentCatalog class with agents array and filter methods
Extend OnboardingState with selectedAgentIds: Set<String> property
event_contracts: OnboardingEvent.agentCategoryFilterChanged(category: AgentCategory) - emitted when user taps filter
OnboardingEvent.agentSearchPerformed(query: String, resultCount: Int) - emitted on search with debounce
OnboardingEvent.agentSelectionChanged(agentId: String, selected: Bool) - emitted on each toggle
OnboardingEvent.agentSelectAllTapped(visibleCount: Int) - emitted when Select All clicked
OnboardingEvent.agentDeselectAllTapped - emitted when Deselect All clicked
ui_states: Loading state: Skeleton grid while agents.json loads (typically under 50ms so may not be visible)
Default state: Grid showing all agents with All filter selected and no search text
Filtered state: Grid showing only agents matching selected category with filter pill highlighted
Search state: Grid showing only agents matching search query with search field active
Empty state: Message shown if filter or search yields no results
Selection state: Cards show checked state with header badge showing count
ui_interactions: Tap category filter pill to filter grid to that category with animated transition
Tap agent card anywhere to toggle its selection checkbox
Tap checkbox directly on card to toggle selection (same as card tap)
Type in search field to filter agents by name or description text
Tap clear button in search field to reset search and show all
Tap Select All to select all currently visible agents
Tap Deselect All to clear all selections
Press arrow keys to navigate between cards with keyboard
Press Space or Enter on focused card to toggle selection
Tap Continue to save selections and proceed to next screen
Tap Back to return to previous screen preserving selections
ui_copy: Choose agents to help you code. You can change these later in Settings.
Try a different filter or search term
edge_cases: User navigates back and forward - selections must persist across navigation
User searches with no results then clears - grid restores to previous filter state
User selects all then changes filter - only newly visible agents should be selected, not hidden ones
User types very fast in search - debounce prevents excessive filtering calls
User has no agents selected and taps Continue - allow proceeding with warning or confirmation
agents.json missing or corrupt - show error state with retry option
Category has zero agents defined - hide that filter option from bar
Screen rotates during filter animation - animation should complete smoothly
failure_modes: agents.json fails to parse - show error state with message explaining bundled data issue and contact support
Memory pressure during grid render - implement cell recycling via LazyVGrid
VoiceOver skips cards - ensure all cards have proper accessibility identifiers and traits
Keyboard focus lost after filter - restore focus to first visible card
Selection state desyncs from UI - use single source of truth in ViewModel with Binding
rollback_plan: Agent selections are stored only in OnboardingState which persists to UserDefaults. If issues occur, clear the selectedAgentIds key from UserDefaults to reset to default state. The agents.json catalog is bundled and immutable. No system changes occur on this screen - all actions are app-local.

acceptance_tests: Given agents.json has 12 agents across 6 categories, when screen loads, then all 12 agents display in grid
Given user taps Planning filter, when animation completes, then only Planning category agents are visible
Given user types 'debug' in search, when debounce completes, then only agents with debug in name or description show
Given user taps an agent card, when tap completes, then card checkbox shows checked state
Given user taps Select All with Planning filter active, when action completes, then only Planning agents are selected
Given user taps Deselect All, when action completes, then all agent checkboxes are unchecked
Given user selects 5 agents and taps Continue, when navigation completes, then OnboardingState.selectedAgentIds contains those 5 IDs
Given user navigates back and returns, when screen reloads, then previous selections are preserved

completed_when: The Agents Recommendations screen loads a grid of agent cards from bundled data, allows filtering by category and search, supports checkbox selection with bulk actions, and saves user selections to OnboardingState when Continue is tapped.
completed_evidence: Screen recording showing grid load, category filter transitions, search filtering, checkbox selection on multiple cards, Select All and Deselect All actions, and successful navigation via Continue with selections persisted. Test report showing unit and UI tests passing.
status_reason: Specified and ready for implementation. No blocking dependencies. Low risk as this is a self-contained UI screen with no external system interactions.
open_questions: Should agents have dependencies on specific CLIs or are all agents CLI-agnostic
What default agents should be pre-selected for new users
Should we show agent complexity or time-to-configure estimates on cards
notes: This is a discovery-focused screen that helps users understand available automation. Card design should emphasize readability and quick scanning. Consider A/B testing default selections to optimize agent adoption rates.

Run swift test --filter AgentsRecommendations to verify all unit tests pass
Launch app in Xcode, navigate to onboarding, verify agents grid screen appears and displays cards
Select multiple agents, change category filter, verify selections persist for non-visible agents
Tap Continue and verify OnboardingState.selectedAgentIds contains expected values

risks: agents.json could be missing or malformed causing screen to fail loading
Grid performance could degrade if agent count grows beyond 50 items
Filter animations may stutter on older Mac hardware
User selections could be lost if app terminates before Continue is tapped
mitigations: Bundle agents.json at build time and validate during CI to ensure it parses correctly
Use LazyVGrid with cell recycling to handle larger catalogs efficiently
Profile animations on Intel MacBook Air as minimum spec and optimize if needed
Persist selection changes immediately to UserDefaults rather than waiting for Continue
risk_register.blast_radius: Affects only Onboarding module and new model files. Does not modify any engine, session, or hook code. User data is limited to selection preferences stored in UserDefaults which can be cleared safely.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If grid performance is poor, simplify to List view without animations. If agents.json fails, show hardcoded minimal agent list. Screen can be skipped entirely by tapping Continue with no selections - agents can be configured later in Settings.
